label: z29 dips after unrewarded/rare a1 trials and S1 belief, much deeper late in episode
terms: (phase!=D2)*belief_lo ;; (phase!=D2)*last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase==D1)*last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase==D2)*last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase!=D2)*(prev_action==1)*(tv("action",-2)==1)*(tv("reward",-2)==0) ;; (phase!=D2)*(np.clip(ep_trial-75,0,25)/25)**2*(prev_action==1)*(prev_reward==0) ;; (phase!=D2)*(np.clip(ep_trial-75,0,25)/25)**2*belief_lo ;; (phase==D2)*(np.clip(ep_trial-75,0,25)/25)**2*(action==1)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 29 sits near 1 (mean 0.977) and its magnitude beyond timing is mostly downward dips tied to a1 choices. At D1/GO it drops after a1 trials that reached S2 (a1 S2 u about -0.05, a1 S2 r about -0.05 at D1 only), smaller dips at D2 (-0.03 after a1 S2 u), and an extra -0.03 when the trial before was also an unrewarded a1. It falls graded with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good (belief_lo, negative weight), and is slightly raised after a2 trials. All of these effects grow strongly late in the episode (ep_trial > ~75): an unrewarded a1 trial late in the episode drops z by a further ~0.1 at D1/GO, belief_lo dependence triples, and at D2 choosing a1 late pulls it down; the deepest values (0.5-0.7) come from runs of unrewarded a1 trials in the final 10 trials. Observed-only: test R^2 beyond timing 0.53 vs the all-cue ceiling 0.61 and all-observed 0.55; earlier model-based explanations used the policy (policy decile alone 0.44), which this observed version matches without model outputs, losing little. No future or hidden variables used.

issues: The test score reproduces: R^2 beyond timing 0.528 on test (timing alone 0.19). The fitted weights match the explanation: a1 S2 u at D1/GO -0.050, a1 S2 r at D1 -0.048, a1 S2 u at D2 -0.029, a second unrewarded a1 back -0.034, late unrewarded a1 -0.109, late belief_lo -0.014, late a1 choice at D2 -0.047.

Leave-one-out on test: every term earns its place. Removing one term gives a test R^2 of 0.451 to 0.517. The base belief_lo term matters least: its weight is only -0.004 per log-odds unit, and dropping it costs 0.046. Most of the belief effect is the late-episode term, so 'falls steadily as belief_lo rises' is a weak effect outside the late episode.
'a1 S2 r only at D1' holds. The residual after a1 S2 r is -0.054 at D1, +0.005 at GO and +0.004 at D2.
'Slightly higher after a2 trials' has no term of its own. The residual table supports it (about +0.02 after a2 at D1/GO), and the belief terms absorb it. Adding a prev_action contrast gives no gain.
Misses show no large systematic class. Mean error by phase is within +/-0.003. The worst (phase, previous trial) cells are only D1 after a2 S1 r (+0.018) and GO after a2 S1 r (+0.014).

The biggest single-window misses (actual about 0.55-0.75, predicted about 0.92) are late steps (t90 and later), mostly early in a window with little visible history. Some follow late unrewarded a1 S1 or a2 S2 trials rather than strict 'runs of unrewarded a1'. So the claim that the lowest values come from runs of unrewarded a1 trials is roughly right but overstated. Split by pattern, the late dip is dominated by a1 S2 u (-0.31), with a1 S1 u at -0.08 and a1 S2 r at -0.08.

There is a little room left. Scaling the early effects by (1+3*late) and using tanh(belief_lo/2) reaches test 0.551, close to the observed-only additive reference of 0.55. The terms otherwise saturate.
